dialogues.dialogue: A diary? Who the hell is Caesar?
Ah, yes. Caesar is the creator of this facility.
He founded the Omni-Ontological-Organization to further advance the integration of technology and mankind.
But now, he has withdrawn from the facility. I suppose he concluded his work was complete and that his service units could sustian the facility from now on.
I suppose he also had some strange fascination with puzzles as well... as evidenced by the layout of all these rooms.
